items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: I had some, I had some, I had some, I had played with some, now a fellow like Troy Weiss died

ctx.x: You got me there. Who did I do? You got me there. I couldn't.
Well, I had some, I had some, I had some, I had played with some, now a fellow like Troy Weiss died, Roy Evans, he was a wonderful drummer.
